# Sweetwater Nail Lounge

> A bright walk-in nail lounge on the Boise Bench. Natural-nail work, honest wear times, and a table you can actually see what you are getting on.

nail lounge in Boise, ID. Walk-ins welcome. Hours: Mon – Sat · 10 AM–7 PM.

## Services
- Gel Manicure — from $55: Shaped, cuticle work, and a gel colour cured to a hard finish. Two to three weeks of honest wear.
- Builder Gel Overlay — from $75: Strength over your own nail with no tip and no extension. For nails that bend or peel.
- Soak-Off Removal — from $25: Gentle removal of gel from anywhere, including sets we did not place. Priced on its own so nobody pays twice.
- Pedicure: Soak, shape, callus work, and polish or gel. Pricing depends on whether you want gel; ask at the desk.
